title: Tool detail runners must apply shared filters via _tool_call_where(query, ...)
answers: how do I add a new MCP tool detail table
shared filters ignored in MCP tool query
filterTestAccounts not applied in tool_tables runner
body:
Every tool detail runner in products/mcp_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/tool_tables.py must build its WHERE through `_tool_call_where(query, date_range, team, extra=...)`. That helper takes the whole query, not a tool name. It applies `tool_scope_exprs(query.toolName)` and `shared_filter_exprs(team, query.properties, query.filterTestAccounts)`.
If a query kind declares the filters in the schema but its WHERE skips them, the UI shows unfiltered data behind filter controls that claim to narrow it.
A new table's query type must be added to the `_ToolDetailQuery` union.
`MCPToolNeighborsQueryRunner` does not use the helper. It calls `shared_filter_exprs` inside its CTE, so a filtered-out call cannot count as a neighbour of the target tool. Keep the filter in the CTE, not the outer WHERE.
